findings.description: In the opening view the cups form a non-collinear diamond/cluster (one cup well behind, one to the right, the coin-stack cup in the middle, one front-left). As the camera orbits continuously toward the performer's front, the same cups become an evenly spaced straight row of four of equal apparent size parallel to his chest (00:05-00:08), then collapse back into a compact 2x2-style cluster at 00:09. The hands only touch individual cups and never slide them, so a fixed 2D arrangement should not re-project from a diamond into a clean line and back during a smooth orbit.
